objective: Search hub-free gadgets, with pinned distinctions allowed, for every three-place knot and decide which knots can build a parity relation without any distinction shared three ways; certify each gadget found and give an invariant of hub-free composition that rules out the others, or record the bound reached.
status: Proved by SURFACE-GLUING-20261024-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof, standard-library check passed). Co-independent relations (excluded tuples pairwise non-adjacent; on three variables the 34 knots) are closed under hub-free gluing, self-gluing and pinning, with glued excluded count |Z_M^0||Z_N^1| + |Z_M^1||Z_N^0|; so relations without a parity face of dimension three or more never produce one. Only the parity knots build parity without hubs, even when non-parity knots are combined; with hubs not-all-equal and pins define parity. Memory is never created without hubs.
title: Which knots build the surface-seeing knot without hubs
